gloss.en: to show, display or make known

meaning.en: montrer 延续 monstrare；monstrare 由 monstrum 构成，与 monere 有较深拉丁词族关系。monitor 经 Latin monitor / monere，是旁支而不是 montrer 的祖先或直接后代。SHOW、WARN、WATCH 不排成一条假的年代链。 Featured Mapping: Pending.
meaning.zh-Hans: montrer 延续 monstrare；monstrare 由 monstrum 构成，与 monere 有较深拉丁词族关系。monitor 经 Latin monitor / monere，是旁支而不是 montrer 的祖先或直接后代。SHOW、WARN、WATCH 不排成一条假的年代链。 Featured Mapping: Pending.

summary.en: French montrer continues Latin monstrare, from monstrum; monstrum is historically connected with monere ‘warn’. Monitor comes directly from Latin monitor ‘one who warns/advises’, also from monere. They are related at a deeper Latin-family level, but monitor is not derived from montrer.
summary.zh-Hans: 法语 montrer 延续拉丁语 monstrare，来自 monstrum；monstrum 历史上与 monere“警示”相关。monitor 直接来自拉丁语 monitor“警示／劝告者”，同样基于 monere。二者在较深拉丁词族层相关，但 monitor 并非由 montrer 派生。

claim.en: French montrer continues Latin monstrare, from monstrum; monstrum is historically connected with monere ‘warn’. Monitor comes directly from Latin monitor ‘one who warns/advises’, also from monere. They are related at a deeper Latin-family level, but monitor is not derived from montrer.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 montrer 延续拉丁语 monstrare，来自 monstrum；monstrum 历史上与 monere“警示”相关。monitor 直接来自拉丁语 monitor“警示／劝告者”，同样基于 monere。二者在较深拉丁词族层相关，但 monitor 并非由 montrer 派生。

claim.en: Similarity is not merely accidental, yet treating montrer and monitor as direct derivatives of each other is inaccurate.
claim.zh-Hans: 二者相似并非纯偶然，但把 montrer 与 monitor 当作彼此直接派生不准确。

summary.en: The shared mon- spelling reflects a real deeper family connection here, but the distinct formation paths monstrare and monitor must remain visible.
summary.zh-Hans: 此处共享 mon- 确有较深词族依据，但 monstrare 与 monitor 的不同构词路径必须保留。

claim.en: The shared mon- spelling reflects a real deeper family connection here, but the distinct formation paths monstrare and monitor must remain visible.
